description: Horse racing entries from Equibase's free entry pages for a track and date (e.g. PRX; without a date, the track's next card): race card with purse, type, distance, surface, starters and post time; with a race number, the field with program number, post position, horse, age/sex, medication, jockey, weight, trainer and morning-line odds. US tracks (CAN for Canada). No past performances or results. Related tools on this server, for a different need: sports_korn_ferry_tour_leaderboard when you need Korn Ferry Tour leaderboard for the current or most recent. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

date.description: Race date YYYY-MM-DD (optional; without it the track's next card from today, US Eastern, up to 7 days ahead)

race.description: Race number 1-20 for the field (optional; without it the race card is returned)

track.description: Equibase track code, e.g. BEL, SA, CD, GP, KEE, WO

name: sports_equibase
title: Horse racing entries from Equibase's free entry pages
